text: So the goal is Micro-Dosing Safety: 30 seconds of regulated breathing, twenty times a day. It's more like physical therapy for a broken nervous system than running a marathon, and how often you do it matters more than how hard.
section: Psychology is the Software; Biology is the Hardware.
reader: someone with trauma, often with addiction, who has done therapy and still reacts the same way, reading to learn why and whether this protocol is for them
